title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Cherry Twist 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Step into a world of fabulous flavour with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Cherry Twist. This isn't your everyday cherry e-liquid; it comes with a delightful twist that keeps your tastebuds guessing. From the moment you inhale, the bold, sweet essence of cherry floods your senses. It’s as though you’ve just bitten into a ripe, juicy cherry plucked straight from the tree, vibrant and bursting with natural sweetness. But wait, there's more. Just as you think you’ve fully embraced the cherry, another layer subtly emerges. It's a twist—a delicate sherbet candy background note that dances in and around the dominant cherry, adding intrigue and depth to the overall flavour profile. This twist is captivating but elusive, encouraging you to take another puff in your quest to pinpoint exactly what it is. Is it a hint of tartness? A dash of spice? The beauty of Cherry Twist is that its unique character keeps you coming back for more, making it an ideal all-day vape. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
